messages.text: Hi Can you give me the noise data in DB for the Kbox 22 at the deferent TH modes? Thank you!
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page
Handed to the team · No dB data in the product listing; needs JD's measured numbers.

The listing doesn't publish dB figures, so I won't guess at them. What it does say is the KBOX runs quiet speed-controlled fans with an integrated PSU, and the three presets are High 22 TH, Medium 16 TH and Low 10 TH, 330 W at the wall at the top end. Noise drops noticeably as you step down, since the fans throttle with the load.

I've asked JD, who handles the hardware, for the measured dB at each preset. He picks this up at 10am ET today and the answer comes to your email. Fastest route if you want it now: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post and mention @nullhashrate.

Where are you planning to run it?
Please send the answer to my email (email hidden)
